selection_reason: All regular convex four-dimensional polytopes with tetrahedral boundary facets; not a selection made after inspecting spectra.
operator: Scalar nearest-neighbor combinatorial Laplacian H=degree*I-A, unit weights derived only from exact adjacency; independent two-component spin copy H tensor I2.
candidate_shell_definition: Each successive distinct eigenvalue in ascending order is one candidate shell. All eigenvectors in that band count. No regrouping or selective subspace after comparison.
capacity_reference: 2*n^2 for n=1..6, used only after constructing operators and exact spectra
occupancy_assumption: One fermion per spin-resolved independent mode. This is declared statistics, not derived from unique geometric edges.
neutral_filling_test: Fill all lower graph-Laplacian bands before the next, with electron count Z; compare to the supplied neutral ground-state shell populations.
risk: A capacity match does not count as an atomic explanation if the same frozen operator fails the filling data. Boundary S3 topology does not by itself determine the spectrum.
scope: New candidate channel arenas, not embeddings of the earlier reciprocal P/N lattice. The conventional dual of the600-cell is not another tetrahedral cellulation. No common P/N/E attachment, spin connection, Pauli derivation, charge assignment, energy scale or nuclear stability is supplied.
